en.s: The Battle of Brenta was fought between the cavalry of the Kingdom of Italy under King Berengar I, and the Hungarians hired by the East Francian king Arnulf of Carinthia, at an unidentified location in northern Italian Peninsula along the river Brenta on 24 September 899. It was one of the earliest battles of the Hungarian invasions of Europe.

zh.s: 899年9月24日，意大利王国国王贝伦加尔一世率领的骑兵，与卡林西亚的阿努尔夫所雇用的匈牙利军队在布伦塔河附近交战。具体地点不详，只知道在意大利半岛北部。这是匈牙利人入侵欧洲早期发生的战役之一。

en.s: The Battle of Leskovac took place on September 24, 1454. During the Ottoman invasion, two Serbian armies were set up, one in Kosovo, and the other in Dubočica, near Leskovac. A large Ottoman force headed from Macedonia was met by Nikola Skobaljić and the Serbs scored a decisive victory over the Ottomans. Nikola Skobalić continued his forays against the Ottomans, operating in Southern Serbia and the Leskovac area, and won several major victories against the armies of the Sultan until Mehmed II himself and to confront the Serbs at the Battle of Trepanje, where Voivode Nikola and his men fought to the last man, inflicting massive casualties on the much larger Ottoman force.

zh.s: 1454年9月24日，奥斯曼军队入侵期间，塞尔维亚人在莱斯科瓦茨附近迎战奥斯曼军队。两支塞尔维亚军队分别驻扎在科索沃和杜博契察（莱斯科瓦茨附近）。从马其顿方向而来的大批奥斯曼军队遭到尼古拉·斯科巴利奇率领的塞尔维亚军队迎击，塞方取得决定性胜利。此后，斯科巴利奇继续在塞尔维亚南部和莱斯科瓦茨一带袭击奥斯曼军队，并多次获胜。后来穆罕默德二世亲自出兵，在特雷潘耶战役中与塞尔维亚人交战；武将尼古拉和部下战斗至最后一人，并使人数远多于己方的奥斯曼军队遭受重大伤亡。

en.s: The siege of Novara took place in the summer and autumn of 1495 during the Italian War of 1494–1495. While king Charles VIII of France was retreating to the north after facing rebellions in the recently conquered Kingdom of Naples, and managed to escape the destruction of his army at the Battle of Fornovo (6 July 1495), his cousin Louis d'Orleans opened a second front by attacking the Duchy of Milan (which had defected to France's enemies) and occupying the city of Novara.

zh.s: 1495年夏秋，意大利战争期间，法军围攻诺瓦拉。法王查理八世在那不勒斯王国遭遇叛乱后向北撤退，并在1495年7月6日的福尔诺沃战役中避免了全军覆没。与此同时，他的堂弟奥尔良的路易袭击了倒向法国敌对阵营的米兰公国，开辟第二战线并占领诺瓦拉。

en.t: Battle of San Juan de Ulúa (1568)
en.s: The Battle of San Juan de Ulúa was fought between English privateers and Spanish forces at San Juan de Ulúa (in modern Veracruz, Mexico). The English flotilla of six armed merchant ships under John Hawkins had been trading along the Spanish Main with the cooperation of local Spanish officials. However, the central Spanish authorities considered this to be illegal smuggling that violated the Treaty of Tordesillas (which England did not recognise).

zh.s: 英国私掠船与西班牙军队在圣胡安·德乌卢阿交战，该地位于今天墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯州境内。约翰·霍金斯率领的英国船队有6艘武装商船，曾在西班牙美洲沿岸贸易，并得到当地西班牙官员配合。但西班牙中央政府认为这属于非法走私，违反了英格兰不承认的《托德西利亚斯条约》。

en.s: The siege of Hulst was a siege of the city of Hulst that took place between 20 and 24 September 1591 by a Dutch and English army under the leadership of Maurice of Orange during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War. The siege was part of Maurice's famous campaign of 1591.

zh.s: 1591年9月20日至24日，奥兰治的莫里斯率领荷兰和英国联军围攻胡尔斯特城。这场围城战发生在八十年战争和英西战争期间，也是莫里斯1591年著名战役中的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Rowton Heath, also known as the Battle of Rowton Moor, occurred on 24 September 1645 during the English Civil War. Fought by the Parliamentarians, commanded by Sydnam Poyntz, and the Royalists under the personal command of King Charles I, it was a significant defeat for the Royalists, with heavy losses and Charles prevented from relieving the Siege of Chester. Prior to the battle, Charles had been attempting to link up with the Marquess of Montrose in Scotland following the Royalist defeat in the Battle of Naseby.

zh.s: 罗顿希思战役（又称罗顿荒原战役）发生于1645年9月24日，是英国内战中的一场战斗。议会军由西德纳姆·波因茨指挥，保王军则由查理一世亲自率领。保王军遭到惨败，伤亡惨重，查理一世也未能赶去解围切斯特。此前，查理一世在内斯比战役失利后，正试图与苏格兰的蒙特罗斯侯爵会合。

en.s: The invasion of Rügen of 22 to 24 September 1678 was a military operation in the Swedish-Brandenburg War, or Scanian War, that ended with the annexation of the Swedish-ruled island of Rügen by the Allies – Brandenburg-Prussia and Denmark – for just under a year before it was restored by treaty to Sweden. The operation was a prelude to the long-planned Siege of Stralsund that followed shortly thereafter.

zh.s: 1678年9月22日至24日，瑞典-勃兰登堡战争（又称斯堪尼亚战争）期间，盟军对吕根岛展开军事行动。勃兰登堡-普鲁士和丹麦联军吞并了由瑞典统治的吕根岛，但不到一年后，瑞典通过条约重新取得该岛。此次行动也为随后筹划已久的施特拉尔松德围城战铺路。

en.s: The Makassar revolt (Thai: กบฏมักกะสัน RTGS: kabot makkasan) of 1686 was an uprising of Makassar residents in Ayutthaya led by Makassar prince Daeng Mangalle. It was the only uprising recorded in the city of Ayutthaya during the reign of King Narai.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1686年，居住在阿瑜陀耶的马卡萨人发动起义，由马卡萨王子达恩·芒加莱领导。泰语称这场起义为“กบฏมักกะสัน”，罗马字转写为 kabot makkasan。在那莱王统治期间，这是阿瑜陀耶城中唯一有记录的起义。

en.s: The Battle of Niš was fought on 24 September 1689, near the city of Niš in southern Serbia, between the forces of the Ottoman Empire, and the forces of the Holy Roman Empire as part of the Great Turkish War. The Austrian Commander, Louis William, Margrave of Baden-Baden; defeated the Ottoman forces and captured the city. When Louis William learned that there are no Ottoman defence positions on Vinik he ordered Nestorović to attack it. Nestorović managed to bypass right wing of Ottoman forces and with this maneuver solved the battle in favor of Austrians.

zh.s: 1689年9月24日，大土耳其战争期间，奥斯曼帝国军队与神圣罗马帝国军队在塞尔维亚南部尼什附近交战。奥地利指挥官巴登-巴登藩侯路德维希·威廉击败奥斯曼军队并攻占尼什。他得知维尼克一带没有奥军防守后，命令内斯托罗维奇发起进攻。内斯托罗维奇绕过奥斯曼军队的右翼，这一行动扭转战局，使奥军获胜。

en.s: The Swedish invasion of Saxony took place in 1706 during the Great Northern War, which began in 1700 when Russia, Denmark–Norway, and Saxony attacked Sweden or its ally, Holstein-Gottorp. To force Augustus II the Strong out of the war, who was the elector of Saxony and king in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, Charles XII of Sweden invaded the Commonwealth; Augustus was dethroned in 1704, and, after a devastating Saxon defeat at Fraustadt, Charles XII marched against Saxony in 1706 with 20,000 men.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1706年大北方战争期间，瑞典军队入侵萨克森。大北方战争于1700年爆发，当时俄罗斯、丹麦-挪威和萨克森进攻瑞典或其盟友荷尔斯泰因-戈托普。瑞典国王卡尔十二世试图迫使萨克森选帝侯、波兰-立陶宛联邦国王奥古斯特二世退出战争，于是入侵联邦。奥古斯特二世于1704年被废黜；萨克森军队在弗劳施塔特遭到惨败后，卡尔十二世于1706年率领2万兵力进军萨克森。

en.s: The Theatre War (Swedish: Teaterkriget), Cowberry War or Cranberry War (Norwegian: Tyttebærkrigen, Danish: Tyttebærkrigen), was a brief war between Denmark–Norway and Sweden, starting on 24 September 1788, formally lasting until 9 July 1789. Although the decision to launch the attack was taken in Denmark, the majority of the attacking soldiers were Norwegians from the Danish-Norwegian army. The attack was directed towards the region known as Bohuslän in Sweden, and was supposed to act as a diversion to relieve Russia, who was an ally of Denmark–Norway and had recently been attacked by Sweden (Gustav III's Russian War).

zh.s: 剧院战争又称越橘战争，是丹麦-挪威与瑞典之间的一场短暂战争，始于1788年9月24日，正式持续到1789年7月9日。丹麦方面决定发动进攻，但进攻部队大多是丹麦-挪威军队中的挪威士兵。军队进攻瑞典的布胡斯兰地区，原本打算以此牵制瑞典，减轻丹麦-挪威盟友俄罗斯所承受的压力。当时瑞典刚对俄罗斯发动古斯塔夫三世俄瑞战争。

en.s: The Judiciary Act of 1789 (ch. 20, 1 Stat. 73) is a United States federal statute enacted on September 24, 1789, during the first session of the First United States Congress. It established the federal judiciary of the United States. Article III, Section 1 of the Constitution prescribed that the "judicial power of the United States, shall be vested in one Supreme Court, and such inferior Courts" as Congress saw fit to establish.

zh.s: 《1789年司法法》（第20章，1 Stat. 73）是美国联邦法律，于1789年9月24日在第一届美国国会第一次会议期间通过。该法设立了美国联邦司法体系。宪法第三条第一款规定，美国司法权应赋予最高法院，以及国会决定设立的下级法院。

en.s: The Battle of Handschuhsheim or Battle of Heidelberg (24 September 1795) saw an 8,000-man force from Habsburg Austria under Peter Vitus von Quosdanovich face 12,000 men from the Republican French army led by Georges Joseph Dufour. Thanks to a devastating cavalry charge, the Austrians routed the French with disproportionate losses. The fight occurred during the War of the First Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars. Handschuhsheim is now a district of Heidelberg, but it was a village north of the city in 1795. In early 1795 many of France's enemies made peace, leaving only Austria and Great Britain in opposition.

zh.t: 汉兹胡斯海姆战役（海德堡战役）
zh.s: 1795年9月24日，第一次反法同盟战争期间，奥地利哈布斯堡军队与法国共和军在海德堡北面的汉兹胡斯海姆交战。奥军由彼得·维图斯·冯·夸斯达诺维奇率领，约有8000人；法军由乔治·约瑟夫·迪富尔率领，约有12000人。奥军发动猛烈的骑兵冲锋，击溃法军，法军损失尤其惨重。当时汉兹胡斯海姆还是海德堡北面的村庄，如今已成为海德堡的一个城区。

en.s: The battle of Hacıhasanlar was a phase of the Russo-Turkish War (1828–1829). On 24 September 1828, the Ottoman corps under the command of Omer Vrioni inflicted a major defeat at Hacıhasanlar near Varna on the Russian army's reconnaissance corps under General Harding, who was besieging Varna.

zh.s: 1828年9月24日，俄土战争期间，奥斯曼军队在瓦尔纳附近的哈吉哈桑拉尔击败俄军侦察部队。奥斯曼军由奥马尔·维里奥尼指挥；俄军当时正围攻瓦尔纳，侦察部队由哈丁将军率领。

en.s: The Capture of Cobija or Peruvian occupation of Cobija was a war action that occurred within the framework of the Salaverry-Santa Cruz War that took place in the Bolivian port of Cobija between the Peruvian expedition of Colonel José Quiroga and the garrison under the command of Colonel Gaspar Aramayo.

zh.s: 萨拉维里-圣克鲁斯战争期间，秘鲁上校何塞·基罗加率领远征军，与加斯帕尔·阿拉马约上校指挥的守军在玻利维亚港口科比哈交战。科比哈被秘鲁军队占领。

en.s: The Battle of Rodeo del Medio, fought in Mendoza Province, Argentina on 24 September 1841, was a battle between the Federalist army of Ángel Pacheco and the Unitarian army of Gregorio Aráoz de Lamadrid during the Argentine Civil Wars. It gave victory to the Federalists that would last for a decade.

zh.t: 罗德奥德尔梅迪奥战役
zh.s: 1841年9月24日，阿根廷内战期间，联邦派军队与统一派军队在阿根廷门多萨省的罗德奥德尔梅迪奥交战。联邦派由安赫尔·帕切科率领，统一派则由格雷戈里奥·阿劳斯·德·拉马德里德指挥。联邦派获胜，并将胜势维持了十年。

en.s: In the Battle of Monterrey (September 21–24, 1846) during the Mexican–American War, General Pedro de Ampudia and the Mexican Army of the North was defeated by the Army of Occupation, a force of United States Regulars, Volunteers, and Texas Rangers under the command of General Zachary Taylor. The hard-fought urban combat led to heavy casualties on both sides.

zh.s: 美墨战争期间，墨西哥军队与美国占领军于1846年9月21日至24日在蒙特雷交战。墨西哥北方军由佩德罗·德·安普迪亚将军率领；美国占领军则由扎卡里·泰勒将军指挥，包括正规军、志愿兵和得克萨斯骑兵。双方在激烈的巷战中都伤亡惨重。

en.s: The Battle of Estero Rojas took place on 24 September 1867, when a Brazilian convoy, coming from Tuyutí to Tuju-Cuê, was attacked by Paraguayan troops under the command of Vallois Rivarola. To a lesser extent, the Brazilian forces, under the command of general Albino de Carvalho, were saved by the arrival of general Manuel Marques de Sousa forces, who repelled the Paraguayans.

zh.s: 1867年9月24日，一支巴西运输队从图尤蒂前往图胡-奎途中，遭到瓦卢瓦·里瓦罗拉指挥的巴拉圭军队袭击。巴西军由阿尔比诺·德·卡瓦略将军指挥，后来曼努埃尔·马尔克斯·德·索萨将军率部赶到，击退了巴拉圭军队，巴西一方因此脱险。

en.t: Seventy-six bishops accepted the primate's invitation to the first conference, which met at Lambeth on 24 September 1867 and sat for four days, the sessions being in private
en.s: The Lambeth Conference convenes as the Archbishop of Canterbury summons an assembly of Anglican bishops every ten years. The first took place at Lambeth in 1867. As regional and national churches freely associate with the Anglican Communion, the Conferences serve a collaborative and consultative function, expressing "the mind of the communion" on issues of the day.

zh.s: 坎特伯雷大主教邀请76名主教参加首次兰柏会议。会议于1867年9月24日在兰柏宫召开，闭门举行，为期4天。坎特伯雷大主教每10年召集一次圣公会主教会议。地区和国家教会可自由加入圣公会；兰柏会议为教会提供交流和协商的平台，就当时的重要议题表达共同立场。

en.t: The 1864 play Heath Cobblers by Aleksis Kivi premieres in Oulu, Finland
en.s: The Cobblers on the Heath (or Heath Cobblers in Douglas Robinson's 1993 translation; Finnish: Nummisuutarit) is a play by Aleksis Kivi, considered one of the greatest Finnish writers. The play was originally written in 1864. However, the play's official premiere took place only three years after Kivi's death; it was performed for the first time in Oulu on 24 September 1875.

zh.t: 亚历克西斯·基维1864年创作的话剧《荒野鞋匠》在奥卢首演
zh.s: 《荒野鞋匠》（也译作《荒野中的鞋匠》，芬兰语名Nummisuutarit）是亚历克西斯·基维创作的话剧，他被视为芬兰最伟大的作家之一。基维于1864年写成该剧，但正式首演是在他去世三年后，于1875年9月24日在奥卢举行。道格拉斯·罗宾逊1993年的译本将剧名译作“Heath Cobblers”。

en.s: The Battle of Shiroyama (城山の戦い, Shiroyama no tatakai) took place on 24 September 1877, in Kagoshima, Japan. It was the final battle of the Satsuma Rebellion, where the heavily outnumbered samurai under Saigō Takamori made their last stand against Imperial Japanese Army troops under the command of General Yamagata Aritomo and Admiral Kawamura Sumiyoshi. The battle culminated in the annihilation of Saigō and his army, marking the end of the Satsuma Rebellion. The Imperial Army's victory consolidated their power, and the Satsuma Rebellion was the last instance of internal mutiny seen in the Empire of Japan.

zh.s: 1877年9月24日，萨摩叛乱的最后一场战斗——城山之战，在日本鹿儿岛打响。萨西乡隆盛率领人数远少于对手的武士，向山县有朋将军和川村纯义海军上将指挥的日本帝国陆军发起最后抵抗。战斗最终以西乡隆盛及其部队覆灭告终，萨摩叛乱也随之结束。日本陆军借此巩固了权力；此后日本帝国境内再未发生内部叛乱。

en.s: The Satsuma Rebellion, known more widely in Japanese as the Seinan War (Japanese: 西南戦争, Hepburn: Seinan Sensō; lit. 'Southwestern War'), was a revolt of disaffected samurai against the new imperial government of the Empire of Japan, nine years into the Meiji era. Its name comes from the Satsuma Domain, which had been influential in the Restoration and became home to unemployed samurai after military reforms rendered their status obsolete.

zh.s: 萨摩叛乱在日语中更常称为西南战争（西南戦争，Seinan Sensō，意为“西南战争”），是明治维新九年后，不满的武士反抗日本新帝国政府的一场起义。叛乱得名于萨摩藩。该藩曾在维新中发挥重要作用；军事改革使武士阶层失去原有地位后，许多失业武士聚集在那里。

en.s: Alfred Deakin (3 August 1856 – 7 October 1919) was the second prime minister of Australia. He served three terms from 1903 to 1904, from 1905 to 1908, and from 1909 to 1910. He held office as the leader of the Protectionist Party, and in his final term as that of the Liberal Party. He is notable for being one of the fathers of Federation and for his influence in early Australian politics.

en.s: The Battle of the Drina (Serbian: Bitka na Drini, Битка на Дрини) was fought between Serbian and Austro-Hungarian armies in September 1914, near Loznica, Serbia, during the First Serbian campaign of World War I. After a first failed invasion of Serbia where he lost 40,000 men, Oskar Potiorek, the Austro-Hungarian commander of the Balkanstreitkräfte, launched a new offensive across the River Drina at the western Serbian border; after successfully crossing the river the night of 7—8 September the Austro-Hungarian forces were stopped facing strong Serbian defensive positions.

en.t: 1975 British Mount Everest Southwest Face expedition
en.s: The 1975 British Mount Everest Southwest Face expedition was the first to successfully climb Mount Everest by ascending one of its faces rather than along its ridges. In the post-monsoon season Chris Bonington led the expedition that used rock climbing techniques to put fixed ropes up the face from the Western Cwm to just below the South Summit. A key aspect of the success of the climb was the scaling of the cliffs of the Rock Band at about 8,200 metres (27,000 ft) by Nick Estcourt and Tut Braithwaite. Two teams then climbed to the South Summit and followed the Southeast Ridge to the main summit – Dougal Haston with Doug Scott on 24 September 1975, who at the South Summit made the highest ever bivouac for that time, and Peter Boardman with Pertemba two days later.

zh.s: 1975年英国珠峰西南壁远征首次沿山壁而非山脊路线成功登顶珠穆朗玛峰。雨季过后，克里斯·博宁顿率队采用攀岩技术，从西坳沿山壁架设固定绳索，一直延伸到南峰下方。尼克·埃斯特科特和图特·布雷思韦特攀上约8200米（27000英尺）高的岩石带，这是登顶成功的关键一环。之后两支队伍登上南峰，再沿东南山脊抵达主峰：道格尔·哈斯顿和道格·斯科特于9月24日登顶；彼得·博德曼和佩尔滕巴则两天后登顶。哈斯顿和斯科特在南峰过夜时，创下当时海拔最高的露营纪录。

en.s: Norodom Sihanouk (; 31 October 1922 – 15 October 2012) was King, Chief of State and Prime Minister of Cambodia. He is known as Samdech Euv (meaning "King Father") or by his nickname The Pink Prince. During his lifetime, Cambodia was under various regimes, from French colonial rule (until 1953), a Japanese puppet state (1945), an independent kingdom (1953–1970), a military republic (1970–1975), the Khmer Rouge regime (1975–1979), a Vietnamese-backed communist regime (1979–1989), a transitional communist regime (1989–1993) to eventually another kingdom (since 1993).

zh.s: 诺罗敦·西哈努克（1922年10月31日—2012年10月15日）曾任柬埔寨国王、国家元首和首相，被称为“国父”或“粉红王子”。其一生中，柬埔寨先后经历法国殖民统治（至1953年）、日本扶植的傀儡政权（1945年）、独立王国（1953—1970年）、军事共和国（1970—1975年）、红色高棉统治（1975—1979年）、越南支持的共产党政权（1979—1989年）、过渡时期共产党政权（1989—1993年），最终于1993年恢复王制。

en.t: India’s Mars Orbiter Mission reaches Mars
en.s: India's Mars Orbiter Mission successfully entered orbit around Mars after an interplanetary journey lasting more than ten months. The spacecraft, also known as Mangalyaan, was operated by the Indian Space Research Organisation. It was designed primarily to demonstrate technologies required for interplanetary flight while carrying instruments to study Mars and its environment. The successful orbital insertion made India the first Asian country to reach Mars orbit and the first country to do so on its initial attempt. The mission became a significant milestone for India's space program, demonstrating navigation, communication, and spacecraft-operation capabilities at a distance far beyond Earth orbit.

en.s: The 2020 UEFA Super Cup was the 45th edition of the UEFA Super Cup, an annual football match organised by UEFA and contested by the reigning champions of the two main European club competitions, the UEFA Champions League and the UEFA Europa League. The match featured German club Bayern Munich, the winners of the 2019–20 UEFA Champions League, and Spanish club Sevilla, the winners of the 2019–20 UEFA Europa League. It was played at the Puskás Aréna in Budapest, Hungary on 24 September 2020.

zh.s: 2020年欧洲超级杯是第45届欧洲超级杯，由欧足联每年举办，参赛双方是欧冠和欧联杯的卫冕冠军。2020年这场比赛由2019—20赛季欧冠冠军拜仁慕尼黑对阵欧联杯冠军塞维利亚，于2020年9月24日在匈牙利布达佩斯的普斯卡什竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2022 Brno municipal election was held on 23 and 24 September 2022 as part of the nationwide municipal elections. en.s: Senate elections were held in the Czech Republic on 23 and 24 September 2022 alongside municipal elections. The election were won by the Spolu alliance consisting of the Civic Democratic Party (ODS), KDU-ČSL and TOP 09 which won 20 seats (including Tábor 2020 candidate Marek Slabý and ProMOST candidate Jan Paparega). The ODS was the most successful party, winning eight seats.

en.s: The Banjska attack (Albanian: Sulmi në Banjskë; Serbian: Напад у Бањској, romanized: Napad u Banjskoj) was an armed assault carried out by Serb militants against the Kosovo Police on 24 September 2023, in the village of Banjska in Northern Kosovo. en.s: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA; ) is an independent agency of the U.S. federal government responsible for the United States' civil space program, as well as research in aeronautics and space. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., NASA operates ten field centers across the US and is organized into three mission directorates: Human Spaceflight, Research and Technology, and Science.

zh.s: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）是美国联邦政府的独立机构，负责美国民用太空计划以及航空和太空研究。NASA总部位于华盛顿特区，在全美运营10个研究中心，并设有人类航天、研究与技术、科学三个任务部门。
